Describe any four of King Ahab’s encounter with prophets and suggest what today’s religious authorities should do in their societies.
Show five consequences of David’s sins in his unlawful marital relationships with Bathsheba and give a lesson learnt from each consequence.

Account on the service delivered by the minor judges, who were not famous in their society, yet they delivered the Israelites from the hands of the enemies as the major judges. Show the relevance of the service to the Tanzanians’ context.
Analyse the circumstances which made Haggai to deliver his prophecy by giving four points.
Explain five differences between the true prophets and the false prophets.
Explain the theme “the Mighty One is coming” in connection with the prophecy of Isaiah about the coming of the Messiah in Isaiah Chapter 1 to 12 by giving five points.
Analyse three groups of people who hated Prophet Jeremiah and then give two reasons for their hatred.
